notes: Group 1 is the first isnad (Harun and Hajjaj, then Ibn Jurayj, Abu al-Zubayr, Jabir). Groups 2 and 3 come after the matn («حدثنيه», «وحدثناه»): the same saying, so they are routes (rule 4); they meet at ابن جريج.
Group 1 ends at Jabir while groups 2 and 3 end at «بهذا الإسناد», so no shared tail is written; each group carries its own levels.
«قال قال ابن جريج أخبرني أبو الزبير» : the first «قال» is the speaker's verb, not a name.
